Text: 💥New blog post: Are LLM agents time-aware? Can they predict wall-clock time of tasks? Can they estimate time they spent?

We study this on a range of tasks, including long-horizon ones (ProgramBench, PaperBench, DeepSWE, etc).

Joint work with my MATS mentee @MOfengenden!
